name: Big Brother
tagline: A browser extension that guides older users step by step through any website, or does the task for them.
problem: Changing interfaces make older adults depend on others for everyday online tasks.
solution: A Chrome extension takes plain-language or voice requests, highlights where to click and what to type on the page, and can act on the user's behalf, using retrieval, page-structure detection and memory.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask how to do something and watch the page light up with the next step.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Keeps the user in control by guiding first and acting only when needed.

lessons: Guiding before acting keeps an assistive agent trustworthy.
